title: Oil of Sharpness
summary: Unobtainable coating adds +3 to attacks and damage with eligible Piercing or Slashing weapons until Long Rest.

fields.Use: Bonus Action to apply to your active weapon. For a Piercing or Slashing weapon, gain +3 on attack rolls and damage until Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
